info.title: Get Package Detail
info.description: Returns information about a package, including handover time slot, tracking number, and shipping provider information.

get.description: Returns information about a package, including handover time slot, tracking number, and shipping provider information.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

orders.description: The response list of TikTok Shop orders.

package_status.description:
Possible values:
- `TO FULFILL`：Waiting for the merchant or warehouse to ship the package.
- `PROCESSING`: Package has been arranged by seller. Waiting for carrier to collect the parcel.
- `FULFILLING`: Package has been collected by carrier and in transit.
- `COMPLETED`: Package has been delivered.
- `CANCELLED`: Package has been canceled. Normally, the package is canceled due to the package being lost or damaged.

package_sub_status.description:
-ISSUE：Package allocation failed, need to contact the platform.
-CREATED：Package has been created
-STOCKING：Platform verification completed, waiting for the merchant to ship
-RTSING：Purchasing shipping label and waiting for the carrier to return results.
-RTS_success：Purchasing shipping label success,seller can print label.
-HBW:Only for FBT order ,has been create to the warehouse
-HBWING:Only for FBT order ,creating to the warehouse
-TTS：Carriers pickup the package.
-Delivery：The package has been delivered to the buyer.
-Ship_exception：Cannot delivered to buyer, maybe damaged or lost.

split_and_combine_tag.description:
Possible values:
- `DEFAULT`: The package has not undergone any combine or split operation.
- `COMBINE`: The package has been consolidated with another order.
- `SPLIT`: The order has been split into multiple orders.

has_multi_skus.description: Whether there are multiple SKU IDs in a package.

note_tag.description:
Possible values:
- `BUYER_UNNOTED`: The order has not been noted by buyer.
- `BUYER_NOTED`: The order has been noted by buyer.

shipping_type.description:
The method of delivery. 
Possible values:
- `TIKTOK`: Shipping service provided by TikTok. The seller should obtain a shipping label from TikTok.
- `SELLER`: Seller provides shipping, including through 3rd party fulfillment providers on behalf of the seller.

delivery_option_name.description: Delivery option name. For display purposes only.

delivery_option_id.description: Order delivery option ID. Delivery option ID is mapped to seller configured logistics templates ID.

last_mile_tracking_number.description: For cross-border order only. Cross-border order last mile tracking number.

start_time.description: Start of the time slot when a package is scheduled to be picked up by carrier. Unix timestamp.

end_time.description: End of time slot when a package is scheduled to be picked up by carrier. Unix timestamp.

handover_method.description:
Whether the package is delivered by pick up or drop off. Possible values:
- `PICKUP`: A Logistics carrier will pickup the package(s) from the seller's pickup address.
- `DROP_OFF`: Seller will need to drop off the package(s) to a designated location.

order_line_item_ids.description: The order line item ID contained in the package.

phone_number.description: The telephone number of the buyer. Please note, if this order use platform logistics, phone number will be desensitized.

name.description: The name of the recipient. Please note, if this order uses platform logistics, recipient name will be desensitized

postal_code.description: The postal code that can be used by seller for shipping (in the U.S, this refers to the ZIP code).

address_line1.description: The first line of the street address

address_line2.description: The second line of the street address.

address_line3.description: The third line of the street address. Usually only for the Brazilian market.

address_line4.description: The fourth line of the street address. Usually only for the Brazilian market.

phone_number.description: The telephone number of the sender.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the sender.

address_line1.description: The first line of the sender's street address.

address_line2.description: The second line of the sender's street address.

address_line3.description: The third line of the sender's street address. Usually only for the Brazilian market.

address_line4.description: The fourth line of the sender's street address. Usually only for the Brazilian market.

value.description: The value of the weight of the scheduled package.

unit.description:
The unit of measurement used to measure the weight. Possible values:
- `GRAM`
- `POUND`

weight.description: The weight of the scheduled package.

length.description: The length of the scheduled package.

width.description: The width of the scheduled package.

height.description: The height of the scheduled package.

unit.description:
The unit of measurement used to measure the length. Possible values:
- `CM`
- `INCH`

dimension.description: The dimensions of the scheduled package.

update_time.description: The time the package has been updated. Unix timestamp.

is_purchased.description: Whether insurance has been purchased for the package.

coverage_amount.description: The insurance coverage amount for the package. Units: USD.

is_claim_eligible.description: Whether the order is eligible for an insurance claim, based on eligible refund reasons.

claim_status.description:
The insurance claim status.
Available values:
- `NOT_STARTED`: Claim has not been initiated for this package.
- `CLAIM_PENDING`: Claim is currently under review.
- `APPROVED`: Claim has been approved.
- `DECLINED`: Claim has been declined.

insurance.description: Provides details of shipping insurance auto-enrolled during label purchase

biz_extension_tags.description:
Special tags for current package if any.
- `NON_MCF`: whether this package was shipped as a MCF order while in fact it is not.

warehouse_id.description: Seller Warehouse id for this package
